## Change

Explain the problem, affected profile or document, and resulting behavior.

## Compatibility

Describe any wire or profile impact. List related schemas, generators, examples,
fixtures, and cases changed, or state that the change is documentation only.

## Validation

Record the commands and results, or explain checks not run. Distinguish
reference-harness checks from evidence against an implementation.

## Review

- [ ] Examples and evidence contain no credentials or private vehicle data.
- [ ] License text, attribution, and third-party notices are preserved.
- [ ] No hosted CI, release automation, or binary publication was added.
